notes.title: PATCH 1.1
notes.content:
We are releasing a patch today.

- Sticky Bombs now lighten bigger areas and intensities are stronger.
- Bug Fix - Enemies couldn't hit you while attacking. It's fixed.
- Bug Fix - When you reload the game after the chasing on C building, there was a bug wouldn't let you proceed. It's fixed.
- Invert Mouse option now properly works.
- Optimization improvements.
- Achievements are now obtainable.
